explanation.text:
LERØY SEAFOOD GROUP ASA (org.nr 975 350 940) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1995-04-07, registered 1995-09-13. Business address: Thormøhlens gate 51B, 5006 BERGEN. Main industry (NACE): 03.211 Produksjon av fisk, bløtdyr, krepsdyr og pigghuder i sjø og brakkvann. Registered employees: 246 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 441,953,000; operating result NOK -435,216,000; net result NOK 1,924,389,000; total assets NOK 13,038,591,000; equity NOK 7,607,762,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 34,409,477,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Henning Kolbjørn Beltestad; board chair Arne Møgster; 8 other board members. Sub-units registered: 7. Website: www.leroy.no. The website describes the company as: "Oppskrifter, inspirasjon og tips og råd som gjør det enkelt å velge sjømat i hverdagen." LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXJ2JK50 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ler%C3%B8y.

How each source was tied to this company:
- brreg_enheter: looked up by org number; record echoes the number
- brreg_roller: roles endpoint addressed by org number
- brreg_underenheter: sub-units filtered on overordnetEnhet = org number and re-checked
- brreg_regnskap: each filing's virksomhet.organisasjonsnummer verified
- gleif: LEI record's registeredAs equals the org number (Norwegian registration authority)
- wikidata: item carries P2333 = org number
- website: URL declared by the company in the registry; page match = orgnr_on_page (high)

First run: 166 facts recorded.
